description: Get one inventory item by id: name, description, status, category and its four relations (home location, current location, current holder, responsible person) with resolved names, plus `photoUrl`, the item's main photo (absent when it has none). Hosts that render widgets draw the result as an item card; show_items draws several items. `status` is the item's CONDITION (available = not defect/lost/retired), so an available item may still be borrowed (`currentHolder`; check_item_availability has the full picture). Packed items (see pack_item) also carry `container` plus `effectiveLocation`/`effectiveHolder`, the position followed from the container while the item's own currentLocation/currentHolder are empty, and `compartment` { id, name } when they sit in one of the container's compartments (a named spot inside it, e.g. a vehicle's «GR4»; absent = directly in the container). Container items carry `holdsItems: true`, `compartments` [{ id, name }] in their order when they have any (the names pack_item's `compartment` takes), `contentsCount`, and `packedStock` when quantity-tracked stock sits inside them: [{ itemId, name, primaryCode?, quantity, compartmentName? }]. A quantity-tracked item whose units sit inside containers carries `packed`: one row per container and compartment { containerId, containerName, containerPath?, compartmentName?, quantity, effectiveLocationName?, effectiveHolderName? }; its `quantity` total counts them. This is the only tool that returns the item's custom field values (serial number, warranty, purchase price, whatever the organization defined): `customFields`, one entry per stored value with the org's own `label`, its `type`, the `value`, and `fieldDefId`, which joins it to the definitions get_item_requirements returns; a `date` value carries `valueIso`, the plain calendar day, and a `currency` value its `currencyCode` (absent = CHF). Values the connected user may not see are absent, not redacted. Drafts (unreviewed captures) are personal: another user's draft is not found even by id (standard not-found) until it is published.
name: get_item
title: Get item
